meta.title: Service providers — San Francisco bathtub waste-and-overflow trip-lever work
meta.verification_method: Every licence row was re-retrieved from the official CSLB licence-detail page on 2026-11-07 during this session; the CSLB 'Data current as of' timestamp for each page is recorded per row. No licence value is inferred.
meta.cslb_caveat: CSLB states that licence status can change at any time and that its database may lag. Re-check the linked page before signing any contract.
meta.review_note: Review-platform ratings and counts are deliberately not published: no official source provides them, and Yelp blocked automated retrieval (HTTP 403). Listing links only, unverified.
